body.name: Finite downward-closed coupled cover
body.construction:
For loopless graphs \(G,H\) on the same \(V\), \(\operatorname{DownCover}_{\mathcal I}(G,H)\) holds when, for every spanning subgraph \(F\subseteq G\) and every \(C\in\mathcal D_F\), there exist a spanning subgraph \(K\subseteq H\), a matrix \(D\in\mathcal D_K\), a surjection \(f:U_C\twoheadrightarrow U_D\), and nonzero scalars \((a_i)_{i\in U_C}\) such that
\[
 C_{:,i}=a_iD_{:,f(i)}\quad(i\in U_C),
 \qquad T_S(C)=T_S(D)\quad(S\in\mathcal I).
\]
Here \(F\subseteq G\) and \(K\subseteq H\) mean inclusion of edge sets on the fixed labeled node set; zero columns and empty visible sets use the conventions of the exact-support cover.
